standard: Schema.org structured data specification — required properties per type

cases.why: Organization block has 'name' but is missing required 'url' — checkSchemaProps pushes {type:'Organization', prop:'url'} to missingProps; RULE_JSON_LD_MISSING_REQUIRED_PROP fires at serious
Article block has 'headline' but is missing required 'author' and 'datePublished' — two entries in missingProps; two separate RULE_JSON_LD_MISSING_REQUIRED_PROP findings at serious
Product block has name:"" (empty string) — the check obj[prop] === '' evaluates as missing; missingProps.push({type:'Product', prop:'name'}); RULE_JSON_LD_MISSING_REQUIRED_PROP fires
